# Predictor Exploration

This document contains exploratory research for our NCAA
championship prediction model. The purpose is to investigate
potential predictors and evaluate model specifications before
using the findings in our DATA 5600 milestones.

## Load and prepare data

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

paths = [
    Path("data/processed/champion_checklist_v2.csv"),
    Path("../data/processed/champion_checklist_v2.csv")
]

data_path = next(p for p in paths if p.exists())
data = pd.read_csv(data_path)

# All historically championship-eligible D1 teams
teams = data.loc[
    ~data["is_reclassifying"].fillna(False)
].copy()

teams["champion_label"] = (
    teams["champion"].eq(True)
).astype(int)

# Historical training period only
train = teams[teams["season"] <= 2021].copy()

print("Training observations:", len(train))
print("Historical champions:", train["champion_label"].sum())
```
